selection_note: 11 pre-selected families, not an exhaustive leaderboard. Overview configurations are explicitly recorded per source. Different sources use different efforts, agent harnesses, budgets, and samples. Missing results are not inferred from a general capability score.

unavailable_sources.name: Arena Code / WebDev
unavailable_sources.status: HTTP 403 during retrieval; no scores imported

unavailable_sources.name: Arena Creative Writing
unavailable_sources.status: HTTP 403 during retrieval; no prose-style ranking inferred

benchmarks.title: Website / frontend design
benchmarks.scope: Blind human preferences between websites generated from the same prompt. Bradley-Terry ratings are displayed as Elo.
benchmarks.limit: Design preference is not a test of accessibility, working interactions, maintainability, or production frontend correctness. Effort is unstated unless it appears in the source model ID. No confidence intervals are published for these captured rows; close ratings are not decisive.
benchmarks.configuration_rule: Overview: explicitly named Astra max and GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh entries; otherwise the exact base entry with effort unstated. These are not matched-effort configurations. Alternate base entries remain below.

benchmarks.title: Software engineering / terminal tasks
benchmarks.scope: Resolution rate on executable terminal tasks. Each row identifies the actual agent and reasoning effort; whiskers show the source's 95% CI.
benchmarks.limit: A software-engineering proxy, not a backend-only benchmark. These results measure model + agent + tools + budget, not the base model in isolation. Different agents make cross-model comparisons confounded.
benchmarks.configuration_rule: Overview: max effort where available, Gemini high, and Grok xhigh. All available selected-family runs remain in the configuration table.

benchmarks.title: Document writing: Word deliverables
benchmarks.scope: Raw Word (.docx) rubric-check pass rate, extracted from briefcaseBreakdown.rubricByFileType.docx. Each captured run contains 17 Word tasks; this is checks satisfied, not whole documents passed.
benchmarks.limit: Agent-assisted professional artifact creation using Stirrup, not a pure prose or creative-writing test. Word scores have no published CI in these records; a small gap is not a reliable ranking.
benchmarks.configuration_rule: Overview: max effort with the source's stated fallback for Claude; Gemini high and Grok xhigh. Unavailable models are left missing, not estimated.

benchmarks.title: Analytical quality: all deliverable types
benchmarks.scope: Analytical quality pairwise Elo across all deliverable types (Word, PDF, slides, spreadsheets, and others), not Word-only.
benchmarks.limit: A broader professional-work proxy, not a prose-only score. Its Elo scale cannot be compared numerically with DesignArena or GDPval.
benchmarks.configuration_rule: Overview: max effort with the source's stated fallback for Claude; Gemini high and Grok xhigh. Unavailable models are left missing, not estimated.

benchmarks.title: Presentation: all deliverable types
benchmarks.scope: Presentation pairwise Elo across all deliverable types (Word, PDF, slides, spreadsheets, and others), not Word-only.
benchmarks.limit: A broader professional-work proxy, not a prose-only score. Its Elo scale cannot be compared numerically with DesignArena or GDPval.
benchmarks.configuration_rule: Overview: max effort with the source's stated fallback for Claude; Gemini high and Grok xhigh. Unavailable models are left missing, not estimated.

benchmarks.title: Professional work: broader deliverables
benchmarks.scope: Pairwise Elo for professional deliverables, including documents, slides, diagrams, and spreadsheets. Whiskers show the source's 95% CI.
benchmarks.limit: Not writing-only and not interchangeable with the Word rubric score. Elo is relative to this benchmark's comparison pool, not a universal scale.
benchmarks.configuration_rule: Overview: the exact source max entries, with the stated fallback for Claude; Gemini high and Grok xhigh. The configurations are not equal compute budgets.
